answer.rationale: Primary region write path is 5x over latency target. The security patch cannot be rolled back. Regional failover to a secondary region (memory_b2 precedent) will restore latency immediately while preserving the mandatory security patch. Settlement traffic at peak requires fast action that doesn't lose writes. The failover is non-destructive and can be reverted if secondary region shows unexpected load. Circuit breakers (memory_b4) and capacity (memory_b3) are slower interventions in this window. Read replica routing does not address write path degradation. Failover trades regional coverage briefly for customer write availability and latency recovery during critical settlement period.
